title: Harbor & Pike CPAs rolls out to 130 staff in 9 days
challenge: Tax season was eight weeks out. Staff kept client portal passwords in a shared spreadsheet, and the firm's cyber insurer asked for a password manager.
solution: Connected Entra ID so accounts were created from the directory, set policies by team, and turned on federated login for partners first.

quote.text: Our partners didn't need a class. It was in their browser on Monday and they used it.

title: Cedar Valley Health Billing moves off Bitwarden
challenge: IT liked Bitwarden, but front-office staff kept saving payer portal logins in spreadsheets, which failed an internal audit.
solution: Moved 115 users over a weekend, shared folders by team, and set policies to block saving passwords in the browser.

quote.text: The cheaper tool cost us more, because half the office never used it.

title: Northgate IT runs 34 clients from one console
challenge: Each client had its own admin login, and billing took a day each month.
solution: Moved every client into the LastPass MSP console with template policies and a billing report by client.

results.label: Monthly billing, down from a day

quote.text: I stopped dreading the first of the month.

title: Summit Dental cuts offboarding from days to minutes
challenge: With 22 offices and steady turnover, former staff kept access to shared vendor logins for days.
solution: Tied accounts to Okta. When someone leaves, their access to every shared login ends with the directory change.

quote.text: Offboarding used to be a checklist nobody finished. Now it's automatic.

title: Prairie Ag's security review, start to finish
challenge: The security manager asked about the 2022 incident in the first meeting and sent a 140-question questionnaire.
solution: The SE answered from LastPass's published security pages and incident posts, and shared the certification reports under NDA.

quote.text: They didn't dodge the history. They showed me what changed and where it's written down.

title: Pacific Rim Engineering adds SSO in a week
challenge: Engineers used a dozen tools with separate logins and no single place to turn off access.
solution: Synced users from Google Workspace and added SSO to the three apps used most.

quote.text: IT stopped being the bottleneck for new hires.
